suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide a graphical user interface to all functions of the system.
The system shall use grid technologies to provide secure and reliable communications to remote computing resources.
The web portal components shall integrate into the Dataportal Web Server at NCAR.
The compute node software shall be developed and deployed for the Hemisphere Linux cluster at CU.
The system shall use the Globus toolkit.
The system shall adhere to NCAR security policies and constraints.
The system shall use the NCAR Mass Storage System for all file based storage.
All GridBGC users shall be required to have valid NCAR Gatekeeper accounts to use the system.
The system shall retrieve all user information from the Gatekeeper account system.
The system shall support the user roles of User and Administrator.
The system shall require the user to enter their username and password to login to the system.
All login actions shall be protected by using secure data channels.
The system shall lock the account after 3 login attempts.
The system shall prevent the user from changing object or project values once that project has been used in a model run.
The system shall support the object states of Unlocked, Locked, and Invalidated.
The system shall require users to enable cookies to use the system.
The web portal shall be usable in Internet Explorer 6.0, Netscape 7.1, and Safari 1.2.1.
